audited_objective: Make Lunar Lake an excellent profile-aware local inference appliance with a reliable dense Qwen route, earned OpenVINO GPU/NPU route promotion, protected BitNet CPU reference behavior, strict regression, and explicit claim boundaries.
decision_reason: The committed evidence supports profile-aware operator readiness, strict regression v2, bounded dense Qwen CPU/OpenVINO quality evidence, profile-scoped route promotion, BitNet semantic-intake protection, post-VALIDATE-002 readiness indexing of low_power power-profile plus thermal temperature availability context, REG-011 route/model identity gating for route-profile and cold/warm benchmark evidence, OP-013 fail-closed default model resolution for blocked auto routes, OP-014 low_power blocked-ask runbook and next-evidence guidance, VALIDATE-003 readiness indexing of that blocked low_power ask receipt, POWER-009/#6097 power-profile indexing of the same runbook and telemetry-context --require-battery guidance with closeout #6099 merged, REG-012/#6102 strict-regression-surface fields for Arc/NPU bounded proof coverage with closeout #6103 merged, REG-013/#6106 strict-regression-surface fields for BitNet CPU reference route evidence with closeout #6107 merged, ASK-006/ASK-007 appliance-level auto ask receipts for ask_normal and ask_short, merged BITNET-INTAKE-004 indexing of pending A770 shared BitNet semantic PRs #4756/#4757/#4767/#4853/#5064, POWER-007/POWER-008 runbook discoverability for the physical battery-mode low_power run, A770-005/#6072 selected-device OpenCL smoke closeout #6079, and A770-006/#6110 selected-device OpenCL matmul_i2s CPU parity closeout #6112 as non-semantic adjacent accelerator evidence. The current swarm main also includes main-history import #104, CLI model-cache module-path fix #100, and Qwen3 comparator support-bundle lock #99 as repo/support-gate updates that do not change Lunar Lake route evidence. The objective is not complete because low_power has no promoted route, current energy-proxy evidence is AC-only, battery-mode telemetry remains blocked by AC power, and thermal temperature readings remain unavailable. POWER-010/#116 plus closeout #117 now add and close out the no-inference low_power battery-plan command and committed lunar-lake-low-power-battery-plan.json receipt. That plan makes the eventual POWER-006 physical battery run machine-readable, but it records can_collect_battery_evidence_now=false from the current AC-blocked telemetry context and does not clear low_power promotion, battery-mode, thermal, speedup, power-advantage, native accelerator, Qwen3 Lunar Lake, or BitNet behavior gaps. The current swarm main also includes SLM-CPU-067/#109 as an adjacent SLM CPU runtime-support update, not Lunar Lake route evidence, route promotion, speedup, broad quality, Qwen3 Lunar Lake promotion, or BitNet behavior proof.
